en.name: Phosphate in blood
en.longDescription: ## Definition & Clinical Context Phosphate (inorganic) is one of the routine electrolytes; its concentration in blood is measured to investigate hypo- or hyperphosphataemia, particularly in critical care, kidney disease, and refeeding syndrome [1]. The source data will typically be a single numeric result per patient-timestamp, produced by a biochemistry analyser. Results are reported as a substance concentration in mmol/L (SI unit) or as a mass concentration in mg/dL [2]. ## Included Concepts The set is anchored on two LOINC Hierarchy concepts (one per blood specimen, scoped to `Chemistry - non-challenge`), with their descendants pulled in. The set resolves to seven LOINC "Lab Test" concepts, grouped here by specimen. ### Serum or plasma (default specimen for routine biochemistry) - *3003458 / 14879-1 — Phosphate [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma (LOINC)*: most widely used LOINC code worldwide. - *3011904 / 2777-1 — Phosphate [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma (LOINC)*: same measurand expressed as mass concentration. - *3050450 / 48617-5 — Phosphate [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma --post dialysis (LOINC)*: point-in-time measurement immediately after a haemodialysis session. - *3049552 / 48641-5 — Phosphate [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma --pre dialysis (LOINC)*: point-in-time measurement immediately before a haemodialysis session. - *40759093 / 55972-4 — Phosphate [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma --post dialysis (LOINC)*: same as `48617-5` expressed as substance concentration. ### Generic blood (specimen unspecified) - *3018913 / 24519-1 — Phosphate [Moles/volume] in Blood (LOINC)* - *3024232 / 2774-8 — Phosphate [Mass/volume] in Blood (LOINC)*: same measurand expressed as mass concentration. **Note on units.** Recommended unit follows LOINC's `EXAMPLE_UCUM_UNITS`: **`mmol/L`** (concept 8753 — millimole per litre) for `[Moles/volume]` codes and **`mg/dL`** (concept 8840) for `[Mass/volume]` codes. Conversion: `1 mmol/L ≈ 3.10 mg/dL` (molar mass of phosphorus = 30.974 g/mol; the LOINC "Phosphate" component refers to inorganic phosphate, reported as elemental phosphorus). ## Excluded Concepts No concepts are explicitly excluded by name. The set deliberately omits the following LOINC concepts: - **Red Blood Cells specimens**: intra-erythrocytic phosphate, specialised research measurement. - **Urine, CSF, body fluid and other specimens**: out of scope for a "blood" concept set. ## Mapping Notes - **Default concept** when the source reports "phosphate", "phosphorus", "P", "PO4", "phosphataemia" without further specification: `3003458 / 14879-1 — Phosphate [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma`. By far the most common LOINC code. - **Source labels the analyte as "phosphorus"**: identical to "phosphate" in this context — both refer to the inorganic phosphate concentration expressed as elemental phosphorus. - **Do not confuse with**: organic phosphate (phospholipids, ATP, etc.), urinary phosphate, intra-erythrocytic phosphate. ## References [1] Regenstrief Institute. LOINC code 14879-1 — Phosphate [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma. Available: https://loinc.org/14879-1/ [2] Nomenclature for Properties and Units (NPU). IFCC/IUPAC. NPU codes (current release). Available: https://npu-terminology.org/npu-database/

reviews.comments:
## Summary
**Needs revision.** Suggest to restrict the set to the phosphate concentrations in serum/plasma and blood (3003458, 3011904, 3018913, 3024232) and drop the pre-/post-dialysis specimens (3049552, 3050450, 40759093) as well as the two LOINC hierarchy (classification) concepts 37062662 and 37064066, which cannot occur as measurement_concept_id in CDM data.

## Use in our quality indicators
- Used in QI03 (Feeding).
- CQL: 3 of 9 concepts are referenced in [`IndicateQi03Feeding.cql`](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi03Feeding.cql?plain=1): [3003458](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi03Feeding.cql?plain=1#L51), [3018913](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi03Feeding.cql?plain=1#L52), [3024232](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi03Feeding.cql?plain=1#L53) (each ID links to its code definition).

## Suggestions
- Restrict the expression to 3003458, 3011904, 3018913 and 3024232 (no descendants); drop the dialysis specimens and the two classification anchors.
